items.title: BandLab Acquires Fully Licensed AI-Powered Music Studio Aiode
items.excerpt: BandLab Technologies has acquired Aiode, an AI-powered music studio built on fully licensed audio-to-audio models developed with professional session musicians and producers, adding it as a third music-making platform alongside BandLab and Cakewalk - bringing consent-based generative tools to a mass creator base.

items.title: GEMA Launches Fully Cleared 'PLAI' Music Dataset for AI Training
items.excerpt: Germany's GEMA officially launched PLAI, a fully cleared music dataset and licensing system for AI developers spanning almost 180,000 recordings across 60+ genres - infrastructure aimed at enabling legally clean, consent-based AI music generation tools rather than scraped models.

items.title: New Generative Instrument For Mac & Windows, Tonefield
items.excerpt: Developer Matt Goodluck has released Tonefield, a generative music instrument for Mac and Windows rebuilt from the discontinued TonePad Pro. Its 16x16 amber-dot step grid uses selectable scales, modes and probability to spin out evolving generative patterns you can record live and export as MIDI or audio.
